title: External skill candidates (cowork discovery)
description: Output of discover-skills.sh: external skill repositories that might already cover a capability gap. Deliberately SEPARATE from library-candidates.json — every entry here is unevaluated and carries no adoption verdict, whereas library-candidates entries are the product of an analyze-stage judgement. Merging the two would let an unreviewed search hit read as a vetted decision.

schema.description: Discriminator. Consumers must reject documents whose schema they do not recognise rather than guessing at the shape.

capability.description: The capability that was searched for, verbatim.

source.description: How the candidates were obtained, e.g. 'cowork search'.

not_library_candidates.description: Human-facing note restating the separation, so the distinction survives a copy-paste out of context.

candidates.description: Zero or more search hits. An empty array is a valid, meaningful result: nothing external was found, so building is the remaining option.

stars.description: Popularity signal only. NOT a quality or safety signal, and never sufficient grounds for adoption.

fit_for_gap.description: The repository's own description. Author-supplied marketing copy, not an assessment.

verdict.description: Fixed by construction. Search relevance is not evaluation; a real verdict requires inspection plus `cowork audit` and `cowork verify` after installation.

risks.description: Required, never empty: every external candidate carries third-party-code risk until audited.
